name: Alterac Mountains
summary: Across the Alterac Mountains, ruined peaks shelter ogres, outlaws, and the remnants of arcane power. Once home to the human kingdom of Alterac and Dalaran’s scholarly magocracy, these highlands draw travelers from nearby foothill settlements and the rebuilding city.

sections.title: The Fallen Kingdom
sections.body:
During the Second War, Alterac stood among humanity’s Seven Kingdoms. King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance of Lordaeron and joined the Old Horde, hoping to save his realm. His treachery was uncovered and crushed, and the kingdom broke into disputed borderlands. After Alterac dissolved, the Third War brought fresh horrors. Its grand stone capital now lies in ruins.

The Crushridge ogres occupy the Ruins of Alterac under Mug'thol’s leadership. Alterac’s surviving human nobles formed the Syndicate, a vicious band of criminals. They fight by force to reclaim their lost estates.

sections.title: The Rebuilding City
sections.body: On the mountains’ western edge, Dalaran’s surviving magi rebuild beside lordamere lake. The demon lord Archimonde devastated the great city-state during the Third War. Its magi raised a massive, opaque violet dome over the ruins, but the shield has since been removed. The kirin tor now rebuild their sanctum in the open. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can be found inside the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: Frontiers of Conflict
sections.body:
Southshore and Tarren Mill are staging grounds for journeys into the peaks. Yeti, mountain lions, and Syndicate footpads roam here. Beneath the snow line, a greater conflict churns.

Deep in the mountain passes, the dwarven Stormpike Guard and the reclusive Frostwolf clan of orcs contest Alterac Valley. They fight over ancient territorial and mining rights.

faq.q: What happened to the Kingdom of Alterac?
faq.answer: During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance to aid the Horde. Lordaeron and Stromgarde crushed the treason and occupied the land. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron in the Third War, Alterac fell into anarchy, and Crushridge ogres took its ruined capital.

aliases: why are there human bandits in alterac
faq.answer: The Syndicate is an outlaw band formed from Alterac’s dispossessed nobility. Former Alteraci royals such as Lord Aliden Perenolde lead it. Cutthroats, highwaymen, and disgraced lords terrorize the surrounding lands and drive out rivals as they fight to reclaim their ancestral domains.

faq.q: What happened to Dalaran's glowing dome?
faq.answer: After Archimonde devastated Dalaran during the Third War, the surviving Kirin Tor raised a protective magical shield over the ruins. The shield has since been removed, and the city is rebuilding in the open. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can be found in the Violet Citadel.

faq.q: Where can I find flight paths or safe inns in Alterac?
faq.answer: Southshore and Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills are the usual staging grounds for journeys into the snowy peaks. Dalaran on the western edge is open to Alliance travelers as the Kirin Tor rebuild it, though it has no flight master. The Horde is hated by the Kirin Tor and attacked on sight in the city.

Alterac Valley is an isolated, snowy vale contested by the dwarven Stormpike Guard and the Frostwolf clan of orcs. The Stormpikes came on an archaeological expedition, provoking an all-out territorial war with the Frostwolves. The Frostwolves had lived peacefully in the valley since their exile in the First War.

Ravenholdt Manor lies hidden in an obscure mountain fold east of the main road. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt commands the secretive guildhall of the League of Assassins, a training ground and haven for skilled rogues from across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find Ravenholdt Manor hidden in Alterac’s eastern cliffs. Lord Jorach Ravenholdt watches over elite contracts, lockpicking drills, and the guild’s secrets.
As a mage, you can walk Dalaran’s rebuilding streets, where arcane currents linger and Kirin Tor mages work. The city remains the devastated heart of human spellcraft.
As an Alliance traveler, you face Crushridge ogres and Syndicate outlaws in the former kingdom.
As a member of the Horde, you can find the Frostwolf clan at home in the secluded mountains. Forsaken agents out of Tarren Mill confront ogres and Syndicate outlaws.
As a herbalist, you can find Wintersbite in Alterac’s frozen crags, its only natural habitat. The herb is an essential component in potent cold-weather concoctions.
